scripts.title: MEDW AIMLOCK & ESP
scripts.features:
-- KEYLESS SCRIPT --
The most universal aimlock & ESP script I’ve ever made.
Supports:
• In-game custom models
• NPCs and bots
• Players
Customizable settings:
• ESP color
• Smoothness
• Aimlock prediction
• Outline and chams transparency
scripts.script:
local P=game:GetService("Players")
local W=game:GetService("Workspace")
local U=game:GetService("UserInputService")
local R=game:GetService("RunService")
local C=game:GetService("CoreGui")
local LP=P.LocalPlayer
local CAM=workspace.CurrentCamera

local AB=false
local E1=false
local E2=false
local E3=false
local H1=false
local B1=false
local H2=false

local FN=20
local FF=400
local PN=320
local PF=160
local TC=false
local CT=nil
local CD=0
local CC=Color3.fromHSV(0,1,1)
local FT=0.5
local OT=0.3
local SM=0.2
local PR=true

local AE={}
local PD={}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- FAST SPAWN PIPELINE
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local eQlist={}
local eQset={}
local eQscheduled=false

local function gF(d)
    if d<=FN then return PN end
    if d>=FF then return PF end
    local t=(d-FN)/(FF-FN)
    t=t*t
    return PN+(PF-PN)*t
end

local DK={door=true,window=true,wall=true,floor=true,ceiling=true,prop=true,decoration=true,furniture=true,stairs=true,railing=true,pipe=true,vent=true,crate=true,barrel=true,container=true}

local function hN(n)
    n=n:lower()
    for w in pairs(DK) do if string.find(n,w,1,true) then return true end end
    return false
end

local function iD(m)
    if hN(m.Name) then return true end
    local p=m.Parent
    local d=0
    while p and d<4 do
        local n=p.Name
        if n=="activemap" or n=="map" or n=="decor" or n=="decorations" then return true end
        if hN(n) then return true end
        p=p.Parent
        d=d+1
    end
    return false
end

local function iSB(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return false end
    if not m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return false end
    if P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return false end
    return true
end

local function iCM(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return false end
    if P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return true end
    if iD(m) then return false end
    if m:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then return true end
    local hH=m:FindFirstChild("Head")~=nil
    local hA=m:FindFirstChild("AnimationController")~=nil
    if (hH or hA) and (m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart) then return true end
    local n=m.Name:lower()
    if (string.find(n,"character",1,true) or string.find(n,"player",1,true) or string.find(n,"bot",1,true)) and (m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart) then return true end
    return false
end

local function gT(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return nil end
    local pl=P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m)
    if pl then return "player",pl end
    if iSB(m) then return "bot",m end
    if iCM(m) then return "custom",m end
    return nil
end

local function gN(m,t,r)
    if t=="player" and r then return r.Name end
    if t=="bot" and r then return r.Name or "Bot" end
    if t=="custom" and r then return r.Name or "Model" end
    return m.Name or "?"
end

local function gB(m)
    local p=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
    if p then return p end
    for _,c in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do if c:IsA("BasePart") then return c end end
    return nil
end

local function cB(m,n)
    local p=gB(m)
    if not p then return nil end
    local bb=Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Size=UDim2.new(0,200,0,50)
    bb.StudsOffset=Vector3.new(0,3,0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop=true
    bb.Parent=p
    local tl=Instance.new("TextLabel")
    tl.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,1,0)
    tl.BackgroundTransparency=1
    tl.Text=n
    tl.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1)
    tl.TextSize=10
    tl.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    tl.TextStrokeTransparency=0.5
    tl.Parent=bb
    return bb
end

local function aE(m,t,r)
    if PD[m] or AE[m] then return end
    PD[m]=true
    task.spawn(function()
        local n=gN(m,t,r)
        if not m.Parent then PD[m]=nil return end
        local hl=Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.FillColor=CC
        hl.OutlineColor=Color3.new(1,1,1)
        hl.FillTransparency=FT
        hl.OutlineTransparency=OT
        hl.Adornee=m
        hl.Parent=m
        local bb=cB(m,n)
        AE[m]={hl,bb}
        PD[m]=nil
    end)
end

local function rE(m)
    local d=AE[m]
    if d then
        if d[1] then d[1]:Destroy() end
        if d[2] then d[2]:Destroy() end
        AE[m]=nil
    end
    PD[m]=nil
end

local function cA()
    for m in pairs(AE) do rE(m) end
end

local function uC()
    for _,d in pairs(AE) do
        if d and d[1] then
            d[1].FillColor=CC
            d[1].FillTransparency=FT
            d[1].OutlineTransparency=OT
        end
    end
end

function pM(m)
    if not m or m==LP.Character then return end
    local t,r=gT(m)
    if not t then
        if AE[m] then rE(m) end
        return
    end
    local en=false
    if t=="player" and E1 then en=true
    elseif t=="bot" and E2 then en=true
    elseif t=="custom" and E3 then en=true
    end
    if not en then
        if AE[m] then rE(m) end
        return
    end
    local ex=AE[m]
    if ex then
        local hl,bb=ex[1],ex[2]
        local br=(not hl or not hl.Parent)
        if not br and bb then
            local p=bb.Parent
            if not p or not p:IsDescendantOf(m) then br=true end
        end
        if not br then return end
        rE(m)
    end
    aE(m,t,r)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- AIM CACHE (set-based for O(1))
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local CP={}
local CB={}
local CBset={}
local CM={}
local CMset={}
local AR=false

local function rP()
    local n={}
    for _,pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl~=LP and pl.Character then
            local ch=pl.Character
            local rt=ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if rt then
                local ap=rt
                if H1 then
                    local hd=ch:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if hd then ap=hd end
                end
                n[#n+1]={aimPart=ap,type="player",ref=pl,model=ch}
            end
        end
    end
    CP=n
end

local function aSB(m)
    if not B1 then return end
    if not m or not m.Parent then return end
    local e=CBset[m]
    if e then
        if e.aimPart and e.aimPart.Parent then return end
        local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not root then return end
        local ap=root
        if H2 then
            local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
        end
        e.aimPart=ap
        return
    end
    if not iSB(m) then return end
    local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local ap=root
    if H2 then
        local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
    end
    local entry={aimPart=ap,type="bot",ref=m,model=m}
    CB[#CB+1]=entry
    CBset[m]=entry
end

local function rSB(m)
    local e=CBset[m]
    if not e then return end
    CBset[m]=nil
    for i=1,#CB do if CB[i]==e then table.remove(CB,i) break end end
end

local function aCM(m)
    if not B1 or not E3 then return end
    if not m or not m.Parent then return end
    if P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return end
    local e=CMset[m]
    if e then
        if e.aimPart and e.aimPart.Parent then return end
        local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
        if not root then return end
        e.aimPart=root
        if H2 then
            local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head") or m:FindFirstChild("head")
            if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then e.aimPart=hd end
        end
        return
    end
    if not iCM(m) then return end
    local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
    if not root then return end
    local ap=root
    if H2 then
        local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head") or m:FindFirstChild("head")
        if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
    end
    local entry={aimPart=ap,type="custom",ref=m,model=m}
    CM[#CM+1]=entry
    CMset[m]=entry
end

local function rCM(m)
    local e=CMset[m]
    if not e then return end
    CMset[m]=nil
    for i=1,#CM do if CM[i]==e then table.remove(CM,i) break end end
end

local function rA()
    if AR then return end
    AR=true
    task.spawn(function()
        rP()
        local nb={}
        local nbs={}
        if B1 then
            local l=W:GetDescendants()
            local b=120
            for i=1,#l,b do
                local s=math.min(i+b-1,#l)
                for j=i,s do
                    local o=l[j]
                    if o:IsA("Model") and iSB(o) then
                        local root=o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if root then
                            local ap=root
                            if H2 then
                                local hd=o:FindFirstChild("Head")
                                if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
                            end
                            local entry={aimPart=ap,type="bot",ref=o,model=o}
                            nb[#nb+1]=entry
                            nbs[o]=entry
                        end
                    end
                end
                R.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
        CB=nb
        CBset=nbs
        local nc={}
        local ncs={}
        if B1 and E3 then
            local l=W:GetDescendants()
            local b=120
            for i=1,#l,b do
                local s=math.min(i+b-1,#l)
                for j=i,s do
                    local o=l[j]
                    if o:IsA("Model") and not P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(o) and iCM(o) then
                        local root=o:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or o.PrimaryPart
                        if root then
                            local ap=root
                            if H2 then
                                local hd=o:FindFirstChild("Head") or o:FindFirstChild("head")
                                if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
                            end
                            local entry={aimPart=ap,type="custom",ref=o,model=o}
                            nc[#nc+1]=entry
                            ncs[o]=entry
                        end
                    end
                end
                R.Heartbeat:Wait()
            end
        end
        CM=nc
        CMset=ncs
        AR=false
    end)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- UNIFIED HANDLER: ESP + AIM в одном проходе
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function handleNew(o)
    if not o or not o.Parent then return end
    local m
    if o:IsA("Model") then
        m=o
    elseif o:IsA("Humanoid") or o:IsA("BasePart") then
        m=o.Parent
        if not m or not m:IsA("Model") then return end
    else
        return
    end
    if E1 or E2 or E3 then pM(m) end
    if B1 then aSB(m) aCM(m) end
end

local function eQ(o)
    if eQset[o] then return end
    eQset[o]=true
    eQlist[#eQlist+1]=o
    if eQscheduled then return end
    eQscheduled=true
    task.defer(function()
        eQscheduled=false
        local items=eQlist
        eQlist={}
        eQset={}
        for i=1,#items do
            handleNew(items[i])
        end
    end)
end

local function sT()
    W.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
        if not (E1 or E2 or E3 or B1) then return end
        local cn=o.ClassName
        if cn=="Model" or cn=="Humanoid" or cn=="BasePart" or cn=="MeshPart" then
            eQ(o)
        end
    end)
    W.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(o)
        if o:IsA("Model") then
            if AE[o] then rE(o) end
            rSB(o)
            rCM(o)
        elseif o:IsA("Humanoid") then
            local m=o.Parent
            if m and m:IsA("Model") then
                if AE[m] then rE(m) end
                rSB(m)
                rCM(m)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function sA()
    rP()
    P.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(pl)
        rP()
        pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
            rP()
            -- Instant process on character spawn
            task.defer(function()
                if ch and ch.Parent then
                    if E1 or E2 or E3 then pM(ch) end
                end
            end)
        end)
        pl.CharacterRemoving:Connect(rP)
    end)
    P.PlayerRemoving:Connect(rP)
    for _,pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        pl.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
            rP()
            task.defer(function()
                if ch and ch.Parent then
                    if E1 or E2 or E3 then pM(ch) end
                end
            end)
        end)
        pl.CharacterRemoving:Connect(rP)
    end
end
sA()

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- CATCH-UP SCAN (lightweight, every 0.35s)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local catchT=0
R.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    catchT=catchT+dt
    if catchT<0.35 then return end
    catchT=0
    if not (E1 or E2 or E3 or B1) then return end
    -- Scan Workspace direct children only (fast)
    local ch=W:GetChildren()
    for i=1,#ch do
        local c=ch[i]
        if c:IsA("Model") and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            if (E1 or E2 or E3) and not AE[c] and not PD[c] then
                pM(c)
            end
            if B1 then
                if not CBset[c] and not CMset[c] and not P:GetPlayerFromCharacter(c) then
                    aSB(c)
                    aCM(c)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ESP REFRESH (batched)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local FS=false
local RQ=false

local function rF()
    if not E1 and not E2 and not E3 then cA() return end
    if FS then RQ=true return end
    FS=true
    task.spawn(function()
        for _,pl in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
            if pl~=LP and pl.Character then pM(pl.Character) end
        end
        local hs={}
        local ms={}
        for _,o in ipairs(W:GetDescendants()) do
            if o:IsA("Humanoid") then hs[#hs+1]=o
            elseif o:IsA("Model") then ms[#ms+1]=o end
        end
        local tot=#hs
        local i=1
        while i<=tot do
            local s=math.min(i+59,tot)
            for j=i,s do
                local m=hs[j].Parent
                if m and m:IsA("Model") then pM(m) end
            end
            i=s+1
            if i<=tot then R.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        end
        tot=#ms
        i=1
        while i<=tot do
            local s=math.min(i+79,tot)
            for j=i,s do pM(ms[j]) end
            i=s+1
            if i<=tot then R.Heartbeat:Wait() end
        end
        FS=false
        if RQ then RQ=false rF() end
    end)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- AIM TARGETING
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function gCT()
    local cl=nil
    local bs=math.huge
    local vp=CAM.ViewportSize
    local cx,cy=vp.X/2,vp.Y/2
    local ch=LP.Character
    local rt=ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local pp=rt and rt.Position or CAM.CFrame.Position
    local tg={}
    for i=#CP,1,-1 do
        local t=CP[i]
        if not t.aimPart or not t.aimPart.Parent then table.remove(CP,i)
        else tg[#tg+1]=t end
    end
    if B1 then
        for m,e in pairs(CBset) do
            if not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then rSB(m)
            else tg[#tg+1]=e end
        end
        if E3 then
            for m,e in pairs(CMset) do
                if not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then rCM(m)
                else tg[#tg+1]=e end
            end
        end
    end
    for _,t in ipairs(tg) do
        local ap=t.aimPart
        local pos=ap.Position
        local sp,os=CAM:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
        if os then
            local dx,dy=sp.X-cx,sp.Y-cy
            local ds=math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy)
            local ddx,ddy,ddz=pp.X-pos.X,pp.Y-pos.Y,pp.Z-pos.Z
            local wd=math.sqrt(ddx*ddx+ddy*ddy+ddz*ddz)
            local ef=gF(wd)
            if ds<=ef then
                local sc=ds+wd*0.04
                if sc<bs then
                    bs=sc
                    cl=t
                    CD=wd
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return cl
end

local function lT()
    if CT and CT.aimPart and CT.aimPart.Parent then
        local ap=CT.aimPart
        local tp=ap.Position
        if PR then
            local v=ap.Velocity or Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            local pd=math.clamp(0.05+(CD/2000),0.02,0.1)
            tp=tp+(v*pd)
        end
        CAM.CFrame=CAM.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(CAM.CFrame.Position,tp),SM)
    else
        CT=nil
    end
end

R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not AB then return end
    if U:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2) then
        if not CT or not CT.aimPart or not CT.aimPart.Parent then CT=gCT() end
        if CT then lT() end
    else
        CT=nil
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- REPAIR CYCLE (every ~0.4s)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local rc=0
R.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    rc=rc+1
    if rc<24 then return end
    rc=0
    for m,d in pairs(AE) do
        if not m.Parent then rE(m)
        else
            local hl,bb=d[1],d[2]
            local br=(not hl or not hl.Parent)
            if not br and bb then
                local p=bb.Parent
                if not p or not p:IsDescendantOf(m) then br=true end
            end
            if br then rE(m) pM(m) end
        end
    end
    for m,e in pairs(CBset) do
        if not m.Parent then rSB(m)
        elseif not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then
            local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                local ap=root
                if H2 then
                    local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
                end
                e.aimPart=ap
            else rSB(m) end
        end
    end
    for m,e in pairs(CMset) do
        if not m.Parent then rCM(m)
        elseif not e.aimPart or not e.aimPart.Parent then
            local root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
            if root then
                local ap=root
                if H2 then
                    local hd=m:FindFirstChild("Head") or m:FindFirstChild("head")
                    if hd and hd:IsA("BasePart") then ap=hd end
                end
                e.aimPart=ap
            else rCM(m) end
        end
    end
end)

local function mkSlider(parent,y,label,mn,mx,ini,cb,fillColor)
    local row=mkRow(parent,y,label)
    local track=Instance.new("Frame")
    track.Size=UDim2.new(0,110,0,4)
    track.Position=UDim2.new(1,-110,0.5,-2)
    track.BackgroundColor3=TRACK_OFF
    track.BorderSizePixel=0
    track.Parent=row
    Instance.new("UICorner",track).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local rel=(ini-mn)/(mx-mn)
    local fill=Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size=UDim2.new(rel,0,1,0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3=fillColor or ACCENT
    fill.BorderSizePixel=0
    fill.Parent=track
    Instance.new("UICorner",fill).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local knob=Instance.new("TextButton")
    knob.Size=UDim2.new(0,10,0,10)
    knob.Position=UDim2.new(rel,-5,0.5,-5)
    knob.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(240,240,245)
    knob.BorderSizePixel=0
    knob.Text=""
    knob.AutoButtonColor=false
    knob.Parent=track
    Instance.new("UICorner",knob).CornerRadius=UDim.new(1,0)
    local dg=false
    local function upd(ip)
        local rx=ip.X-track.AbsolutePosition.X
        local w=track.AbsoluteSize.X
        local v=math.clamp(rx/w,0,1)*(mx-mn)+mn
        v=math.round(v*100)/100
        local rv=(v-mn)/(mx-mn)
        fill.Size=UDim2.new(rv,0,1,0)
        knob.Position=UDim2.new(rv,-5,0.5,-5)
        cb(v)
    end
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dg=true upd(inp.Position) end
    end)
    U.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
        if dg and inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then upd(inp.Position) end
    end)
    U.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dg=false end
    end)
    track.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
        if inp.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then upd(inp.Position) dg=true end
    end)
    return fill,knob
end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local TARGET_PLACE_ID = 72742428103609
local allowedPlayerName = "Yo Username Here"

local function createGui(player)
	if player.Name ~= allowedPlayerName then
		return
	end

	-- Prevent duplicate GUI
	local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	if playerGui:FindFirstChild("Vata909tt_IsBackGui") then
		playerGui.Vata909tt_IsBackGui:Destroy()
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "Vata909tt_IsBackGui"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.Parent = playerGui

	--==================================================
	-- MAIN FRAME
	--==================================================

	local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
	mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 320)
	mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0.3, 0)
	mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
	mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
	mainFrame.Visible = false
	mainFrame.Parent = gui

	local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	mainCorner.Parent = mainFrame

	--==================================================
	-- TITLE BAR
	--==================================================

	local titleBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
	titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
	titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50)
	titleBar.Text = "Vata909tt GUI"
	titleBar.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	titleBar.TextSize = 16
	titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

	local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
	titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

	--==================================================
	-- SCROLL FRAME
	--==================================================

	local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	scroll.Name = "ScrollFrame"
	scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -60)
	scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 40)
	scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	scroll.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 6
	scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	scroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
	scroll.Parent = mainFrame

	local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
	layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	layout.Parent = scroll

	--==================================================
	-- TOGGLE BUTTON
	--==================================================

	local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	toggleBtn.Name = "ToggleButton"
	toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 0, 30)
	toggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
	toggleBtn.Text = "Open GUI"
	toggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	toggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	toggleBtn.TextSize = 14
	toggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
	toggleBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	toggleBtn.Parent = gui

	local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	toggleCorner.Parent = toggleBtn

	--==================================================
	-- DRAGGING
	--==================================================

	local dragging = false
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos

	titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = mainFrame.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart

			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if camera then
				local viewport = camera.ViewportSize

				local newX = math.clamp(
					startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
					0,
					math.max(0, viewport.X - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.X)
				)

				local newY = math.clamp(
					startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y,
					0,
					math.max(0, viewport.Y - mainFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y)
				)

				mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
					startPos.X.Scale,
					newX,
					startPos.Y.Scale,
					newY
				)
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- BUTTON CREATOR
	--==================================================

	local function addButton(text, callback)
		local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")

		btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
		btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		btn.TextSize = 14
		btn.Text = text
		btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
		btn.Parent = scroll

		local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		corner.Parent = btn

		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			local success, err = pcall(callback)

			if not success then
				warn("GUI button error:", err)
			end
		end)

		return btn
	end

	--==================================================
	-- MAKE HINT
	--==================================================

	addButton("Make Hint", function()
		local hint = Instance.new("Hint")
		hint.Text = "THIS SERVER HAS BEEN HACKED BY VATA909TT!! DISC INVITE: https://discord.gg/sbTnFCrVj"
		hint.Parent = workspace

		Debris:AddItem(hint, 10)
	end)

	addButton("Relam", function()
		local playerList = Players:GetPlayers()

		if #playerList == 0 then
			return
		end

		local success, result = pcall(function()
			return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(TARGET_PLACE_ID, playerList)
		end)

		if not success then
			warn("Teleport failed:", result)
		end
	end)
	
	addButton("Make Message", function()
		local message = Instance.new("Message")
		message.Text = "THIS SERVER HAS BEEN HACKED BY VATA909TT!! DISC INVITE: https://discord.gg/sbTnFCrVj"
		message.Parent = workspace

		Debris:AddItem(message, 5)
	end)


	--==================================================
	-- FALLING HEADS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Spawn Falling Heads", function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			local head = Instance.new("Part")

			head.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
			head.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			head.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 200)
			head.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			head.Name = "FallingHead"

			head.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.random(-10, 10),
				math.random(20, 30),
				math.random(-10, 10)
			)

			head.Anchored = false
			head.CanCollide = true
			head.Parent = workspace

			local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
			decal.Texture = "rbxassetid://7075746925"
			decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			decal.Parent = head

			Debris:AddItem(head, 10)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- ADD DECALS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Add Decals", function()
		local decalTextureId = "rbxassetid://73859504735494"

		local faces = {
			Enum.NormalId.Front,
			Enum.NormalId.Back,
			Enum.NormalId.Left,
			Enum.NormalId.Right,
			Enum.NormalId.Top,
			Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		}

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then

				-- Skip characters/NPCs
				local parentModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

				if not (
					parentModel
						and parentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					) then

					-- Remove existing decals
					for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("Decal") then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end

					-- Add decal to all six faces
					for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
						local decal = Instance.new("Decal")

						decal.Name = "VataDecal"
						decal.Texture = decalTextureId
						decal.Face = face
						decal.Transparency = 0

						decal.Parent = part
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- SKY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Sky", function()
		local skyTextureId = "rbxassetid://71869538800676"

		-- Remove old skies
		for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sky") then
				obj:Destroy()
			end
		end

		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")

		sky.Name = "VataSky"
		sky.SkyboxBk = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxDn = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxFt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxLf = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxRt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxUp = skyTextureId

		sky.Parent = Lighting
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- FLIP GRAVITY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Flip Gravity", function()
		if workspace.Gravity == 196.2 then
			workspace.Gravity = -196.2
		else
			workspace.Gravity = 196.2
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- RANDOM TELEPORT ALL
	--==================================================

	addButton("Random Teleport All", function()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p.Character then
				local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if root then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
						math.random(-100, 100),
						math.random(10, 50),

scripts.title: Scp 096 beta classic version scp games and Scp monsters
scripts.features: Scp
scripts.script:
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- SCP-096 SL - STRICT STATE MACHINE AI (SMART PATHFINDING, MULTI-TAB)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if getgenv().SCP096_GUI then
    pcall(function() getgenv().SCP096_GUI:Destroy() end)
end
getgenv().SCP096_GUI = nil

local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ReplicatedFirst = game:GetService("ReplicatedFirst")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- UI Library Setup
local Library = nil
local uiLoadSuccess = pcall(function()
    Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
end)

if not uiLoadSuccess or not Library then
    Library = {
        CreateLib = function()
            local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            ScreenGui.Name = "SCP096FallbackGUI"
            ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
            getgenv().SCP096_GUI = ScreenGui

            local function createSection(frame)
                return {
                    NewToggle = function(self, text, desc, callback)
                        local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
                        toggle.Text = text .. " (off)"
                        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
                        toggle.Parent = frame
                        local state = false
                        toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                            state = not state
                            toggle.Text = text .. (state and " (on)" or " (off)")
                            callback(state)
                        end)
                    end,
                    NewButton = function(self, text, desc, callback)
                        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
                        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
                        btn.Text = text
                        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,100,200)
                        btn.Parent = frame
                        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
                    end
                }
            end

            return {
                NewTab = function(self, name)
                    local frame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
                    frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 260)
                    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + (#ScreenGui:GetChildren() * 230), 0, 100)
                    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30,30,30)
                    frame.Name = name
                    frame.Parent = ScreenGui
                    
                    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
                    title.Text = name
                    title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
                    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    title.Parent = frame

                    local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
                    listLayout.Parent = frame
                    listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

                    return {
                        NewSection = function() return createSection(frame) end
                    }
                end
            }
        end
    }
end

local Window = Library.CreateLib("SCP-096 SL", "DarkTheme")
local TabControl = Window:NewTab("Control")
local TabTeleports = Window:NewTab("Teleports & Teams")
local TabNPCKill = Window:NewTab("NPC Loop Kill")

local SecControl = TabControl:NewSection("SCP-096 State Machine")
local SecTeleports = TabTeleports:NewSection("Utility")
local SecNPCKill = TabNPCKill:NewSection("Fast Loop Kill")

-- Configuration & State Definitions
local BUBBLE_RADIUS = 4.0 
local KILL_DISTANCE = 4.0
local RUN_START_DELAY = 1.2
local MIN_CHASE_DURATION = 4.0
local KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION = 4.0
local HEALTH_MAX = 3000
local CRITICAL_CHANCE = 10
local KILL_COOLDOWN = 1.0
local SUPER_FAR_DISTANCE = 300 

local RUN_TOOL = "096 - Run"
local IDLE_TOOL = "096 - Idle"
local KILL_TOOL = "096 - Kill"

local currentState = "IDLE"
local aiEnabled = false
local manualModeEnabled = false
local npcTestingEnabled = false
local showBubble = false
local fastNpcLoopKillEnabled = false

local currentTarget = nil
local stateStartTime = 0
local chaseStartTime = 0
local touchConnection = nil
local bubblePart = nil
local isKillingActive = false
local lastScanTime = 0
local lastKillEndTime = 0
local lastPathTime = 0

-- Smooth Pathfinding Variables
local lastTargetPos = nil
local currentWaypoints = nil
local currentWaypointIndex = 1

-- Emote & Notice Variables
local hasTriggeredNotice = false
local tPoseTrack = nil

-- Client-Side (FE bypass inside self) Audio Setup
local function createLocalSound(name, id)
    local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound.Name = name
    sound.SoundId = id
    sound.Volume = 1.5
    sound.Looped = true
    sound.Parent = SoundService
    return sound
end

local IdleSound = createLocalSound("IdleSound", "rbxassetid://491877423")
local NoticeSound = createLocalSound("NoticeSound", "rbxassetid://491877470")
local ScreamingSound = createLocalSound("ScreamingSound", "rbxassetid://491877546")
NoticeSound.Looped = false

-- Audio Utils
local function getSoundParent()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return SoundService end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Head") or SoundService
end

-- Synchronized Dual Kill Audio
local function playSyncKillAudioFE()
    local parent = getSoundParent()
    
    local sound1 = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound1.SoundId = "rbxassetid://531421188"
    sound1.Volume = 1.5
    sound1.Parent = parent
    
    local sound2 = Instance.new("Sound")
    sound2.SoundId = "rbxassetid://17878427121"
    sound2.Volume = 1.5
    sound2.Parent = parent
    
    sound1:Play()
    sound2:Play()
    
    sound1.Ended:Connect(function() sound1:Destroy() end)
    sound2.Ended:Connect(function() sound2:Destroy() end)
end

-- Input Utils
local function autoClickScreen()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char then
        for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if tool:IsA("Tool") then tool:Activate() end
        end
    end
    pcall(function()
        local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        if cam then
            local center = cam.ViewportSize / 2
            VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(center.X, center.Y, 0, true, game, 0)
            task.wait(0.05)
            VirtualInputManager:SendMouseButtonEvent(center.X, center.Y, 0, false, game, 0)
        end
    end)
end

-- Tools & Animation Utils
local function getTool(name)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild(name) then return char:FindFirstChild(name) end
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
    return backpack and backpack:FindFirstChild(name)
end

local function equipTool(name)
    local tool = getTool(name)
    local humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if tool and humanoid and tool.Parent ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
        humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
    end
end

local function unequipAllToolsFast()
    local humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then humanoid:UnequipTools() end
end

local function isToolEquipped(name)
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    return char and char:FindFirstChild(name) ~= nil
end

-- T-Pose Emote Logic
local function playTPoseEmote()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end
    
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://116099256350648"
    
    tPoseTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
    tPoseTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    tPoseTrack:Play()
    
    if not IdleSound.IsPlaying then IdleSound:Play() end
end

local currentAnimTrack = nil
local function playKillAnimation()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil end
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator", humanoid)
    local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
    -- Updated to new Classic SCP 096 Kill Animation
    anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://15172539171"
    
    local success, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
    if success and track then
        if currentAnimTrack then currentAnimTrack:Stop() end
        currentAnimTrack = track
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
        track:Play(0.1, 1, 1.0)
        return track
    end
    return nil
end

local function calculateDamage()
    return math.random(1, 100) <= CRITICAL_CHANCE and (10^30 + 10^18) or 500
end

local function executeKillTarget(targetHum)
    if not targetHum or targetHum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local damage = calculateDamage()
    local shotgun = getTool("Shotgun")
    if shotgun and shotgun:FindFirstChild("Receiver") then
        shotgun.Receiver:FireServer("Damage", targetHum, damage)
    else
        targetHum.Health = 0
    end
end

-- State Transitions
local function transitionToIdle()
    currentState = "IDLE"
    currentTarget = nil
    isKillingActive = false
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(IDLE_TOOL)
    lastKillEndTime = os.clock()
    
    if ScreamingSound.IsPlaying then ScreamingSound:Stop() end
    if not IdleSound.IsPlaying then IdleSound:Play() end
    
    -- Reset pathfinding smoothing variables
    lastTargetPos = nil
    currentWaypoints = nil
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if currentState == "IDLE" then autoClickScreen() end
    end)
end

local function doTeleport()
    local block = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Block")
    if block then
        local parts = block:GetChildren()
        if parts[198] and LocalPlayer.Character then
            local targetPart = parts[198]
            local lookVector = targetPart.CFrame.LookVector
            LocalPlayer.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPart.Position, targetPart.Position + lookVector))
        end
    end
    transitionToIdle()
end

local function transitionToRunStart(targetModel)
    if currentState ~= "IDLE" or not targetModel then return end
    if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
    
    currentState = "RUN_START"
    currentTarget = targetModel
    stateStartTime = os.clock()
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(RUN_TOOL)
    
    IdleSound:Stop()
    if not ScreamingSound.IsPlaying then ScreamingSound:Play() end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.15)
        if currentState == "RUN_START" or currentState == "CHASE" then
            autoClickScreen()
        end
    end)
end

local function transitionToChase()
    if currentState ~= "RUN_START" then return end
    currentState = "CHASE"
    chaseStartTime = os.clock()
end

local function transitionToKill(targetHumanoid)
    if currentState ~= "CHASE" or isKillingActive or not targetHumanoid then return end
    currentState = "KILL"
    isKillingActive = true
    unequipAllToolsFast()
    equipTool(KILL_TOOL)
    playSyncKillAudioFE()

    -- Mute Screaming audio during kill animation
    ScreamingSound.Volume = 0

    local track = playKillAnimation()
    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(targetHumanoid.Parent) ~= nil

    task.spawn(function()
        local startTime = os.clock()
        
        if not isPlayer then
            if track then track:AdjustSpeed(10) end 
            local godModeTriggered = false
            
            while targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 do
                executeKillTarget(targetHumanoid)
                
                if os.clock() - startTime > 2.0 and not godModeTriggered then
                    godModeTriggered = true
                    if track then track:Stop() end
                    local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum then
                        for _, playingTrack in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                            playingTrack:Stop()
                        end
                    end
                end
                task.wait(0.1) 
            end
        else
            local animDuration = (track and track.Length > 0) and track.Length or KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION
            while (os.clock() - startTime < animDuration) do
                if targetHumanoid and targetHumanoid.Parent and targetHumanoid.Health > 0 then
                    executeKillTarget(targetHumanoid)
                end
                task.wait(0.15)
            end
        end
        
        if track then track:Stop() end
        
        -- Restore Screaming audio volume and go Idle, stopping chase
        ScreamingSound.Volume = 1.5
        transitionToIdle()
    end)
end

-- Invisible Kill Tool
local function giveCustomKillTool()
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
    if not backpack then return end

    local oldTool = backpack:FindFirstChild(KILL_TOOL) or (LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild(KILL_TOOL))
    if oldTool then oldTool:Destroy() end

    local killTool = Instance.new("Tool")
    killTool.Name = KILL_TOOL
    killTool.RequiresHandle = true
    killTool.CanBeDropped = false
    killTool.Parent = backpack

    local handle = Instance.new("Part")
    handle.Name = "Handle"
    handle.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
    handle.Transparency = 1
    handle.CanCollide = false
    handle.Parent = killTool
end

-- Touch Detection (Includes Fixed Manual Touch Kill)
local function setupTouchListener()
    if touchConnection then touchConnection:Disconnect() end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not root then return end

    touchConnection = root.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
        local hitModel = hit.Parent
        if not hitModel or hitModel == char then return end
        local pHum = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not pHum or pHum.Health <= 0 then return end

        if manualModeEnabled and isToolEquipped(KILL_TOOL) and not isKillingActive then
            if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
            isKillingActive = true
            playSyncKillAudioFE()
            ScreamingSound.Volume = 0
            
            local track = playKillAnimation()
            local animDuration = (track and track.Length > 0) and track.Length or KILL_ANIMATION_DURATION

            task.spawn(function()
                local startTime = os.clock()
                while (os.clock() - startTime < animDuration) do
                    executeKillTarget(pHum)
                    task.wait(0.15)
                end
                if track then track:Stop() end
                isKillingActive = false
                lastKillEndTime = os.clock()
                ScreamingSound.Volume = 1.5
            end)
        elseif aiEnabled and currentState == "IDLE" then
            if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
            local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hitModel) ~= nil
            if not npcTestingEnabled or not isPlayer then
                transitionToRunStart(hitModel)
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Initialization & Respawn
LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    task.wait(0.5)
    setupTouchListener()
    playTPoseEmote()
end)
if LocalPlayer.Character then 
    setupTouchListener() 
    playTPoseEmote()
end

-- UI: Tab 1 - Control
SecControl:NewButton("Get shotgun", "Teleport to shotgun and equip", function()
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(-789.93, 3.0, 27.41))
        task.wait(0.1)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
    end
end)
SecControl:NewButton("Give custom 096 - Kill", "Creates invisible kill tool", giveCustomKillTool)
SecControl:NewToggle("Act like 096 (State Machine AI)", "Strict sequence AI", function(state)
    aiEnabled = state
    manualModeEnabled = false; npcTestingEnabled = false
    transitionToIdle()
    if state and not getTool(KILL_TOOL) then giveCustomKillTool() end
end)
SecControl:NewToggle("Manual Control", "Touch-kill only works when 096 - Kill is equipped", function(state)
    manualModeEnabled = state
    if state then aiEnabled = false; npcTestingEnabled = false; currentTarget = nil end
end)
SecControl:NewToggle("Show Bubble", "Display 4.0 stud detection bubble", function(state)
    showBubble = state
    if not state and bubblePart then bubblePart:Destroy(); bubblePart = nil end
end)

-- UI: Tab 2 - Teleports & Teams
SecTeleports:NewButton("FE Custom Team (Scp096Sl)", "Creates & joins team so you take gun damage", function()
    local team = Teams:FindFirstChild("Scp096Sl")
    if not team then
        team = Instance.new("Team")
        team.Name = "Scp096Sl"
        team.TeamColor = BrickColor.new("Really red")
        team.AutoAssignable = false
        team.Parent = Teams
    end
    LocalPlayer.Team = team
end)
SecTeleports:NewButton("FE Name Tag Remover", "Removes Billboard/SurfaceGuis and DisplayNames", function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    for _, v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BillboardGui") or v:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
            v.Enabled = false; v:Destroy()
        end
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then hum.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None end
end)
SecTeleports:NewButton("Teleport to Place Manually", "Teleports to block 198, resets chases", doTeleport)

-- UI: Tab 3 - NPC Kill
SecNPCKill:NewToggle("Fast Loop Kill NPC", "Instantly loops shotgun damage on SCP 096SL without lag/sound", function(state)
    fastNpcLoopKillEnabled = state
end)

-- Background Loops
-- 1. Fast NPC Loop Kill
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait() do
        if fastNpcLoopKillEnabled then
            local target = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SCP 096SL")
            if target then
                local tHum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tHum and tHum.Health > 0 then
                    local shotgun = getTool("Shotgun")
                    if shotgun and shotgun:FindFirstChild("Receiver") then
                        shotgun.Receiver:FireServer("Damage", tHum, 10^30)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- 2. NPC Ignore & Fast Regen (God Mode)
task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(0.1) do
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then
                hum.MaxHealth = 3000
                if hum.Health < 3000 then hum.Health = 3000 end
            end
            
            -- Clear player tags so NPCs ignore the user
            local pTag = char:FindFirstChild("Player") or char:FindFirstChild("TargetTag")
            if pTag then pTag:Destroy() end
        end
    end
end)

-- Main State Machine Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if showBubble then
        if not bubblePart then
            bubblePart = Instance.new("Part")
            bubblePart.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball; bubblePart.Size = Vector3.new(BUBBLE_RADIUS*2, BUBBLE_RADIUS*2, BUBBLE_RADIUS*2)
            bubblePart.Transparency = 0.7; bubblePart.Anchored = true; bubblePart.CanCollide = false
            bubblePart.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField; bubblePart.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Cyan")
            bubblePart.Parent = Workspace
            
            bubblePart.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
                if not aiEnabled or currentState ~= "IDLE" then return end
                local hitModel = hit.Parent
                if hitModel and hitModel ~= char then
                    local hum = hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                        equipTool(RUN_TOOL)
                        autoClickScreen()
                        transitionToRunStart(hitModel)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        if root then bubblePart.Position = root.Position end
    end

    if not aiEnabled or not char or not humanoid or not root then return end

    -- Notice Trigger Detection
    if not hasTriggeredNotice and currentState == "IDLE" then
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                local pChar = player.Character
                local pRoot = pChar and (pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                if pRoot and (root.Position - pRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 9 then
                    hasTriggeredNotice = true
                    if tPoseTrack then tPoseTrack:Stop() end
                    
                    IdleSound:Stop()
                    NoticeSound:Play()
                    
                    -- Reset Idle Animation by unequipping and equipping
                    unequipAllToolsFast()
                    task.wait(0.1)
                    equipTool(IDLE_TOOL)
                    
                    -- Play sound again after reset
                    IdleSound:Play()
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if currentState == "IDLE" then
        if not isToolEquipped(IDLE_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(IDLE_TOOL) end
        if os.clock() - lastKillEndTime < KILL_COOLDOWN then return end
        
        if os.clock() - lastScanTime >= 0.2 then
            lastScanTime = os.clock()
            
            local specificTarget = Workspace:FindFirstChild("SCP 096SL")
            if specificTarget then
                local tRoot = specificTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local tHum = specificTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if tRoot and tHum and tHum.Health > 0 and (root.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude <= BUBBLE_RADIUS then
                    transitionToRunStart(specificTarget)
                    return
                end
            end

            for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= LocalPlayer then
                    local pChar = player.Character
                    local pRoot = pChar and (pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or pChar:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                    local pHum = pChar and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                    if pRoot and pHum and pHum.Health > 0 and (root.Position - pRoot.Position).Magnitude <= BUBBLE_RADIUS then
                        transitionToRunStart(pChar)
                        return
                    end
                end
            end
        end

    elseif currentState == "RUN_START" then
        if not isToolEquipped(RUN_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(RUN_TOOL) end
        if os.clock() - stateStartTime >= RUN_START_DELAY then transitionToChase() end

    elseif currentState == "CHASE" then
        if not currentTarget or not currentTarget.Parent then transitionToIdle(); return end
        local targetHum = currentTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local targetRoot = currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTarget:FindFirstChild("Torso")

        if targetHum and targetHum.Health <= 0 then
            transitionToIdle()
            return
        end

        if not targetHum or not targetRoot then transitionToIdle(); return end
        if not isToolEquipped(RUN_TOOL) then unequipAllToolsFast(); equipTool(RUN_TOOL) end

        local distToTarget = (root.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
        
        if distToTarget > SUPER_FAR_DISTANCE then
            -- Target is too far, freeze movement but maintain state and run animation
            humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position) 
        else
            if os.clock() - lastPathTime >= 0.2 then
                lastPathTime = os.clock()
                local targetPos = targetRoot.Position
                
                if not lastTargetPos or (lastTargetPos - targetPos).Magnitude > 3.0 then
                    lastTargetPos = targetPos
                    -- Smart Pathfinding Config
                    local path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
                        AgentRadius = 2.0, 
                        AgentHeight = 5.0, 
                        WaypointSpacing = 4.0,
                        AgentCanJump = true
                    })
                    path:ComputeAsync(root.Position, targetPos)
                    
                    if path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
                        currentWaypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
                        currentWaypointIndex = 2
                    else
                        -- Path blocked (doors closed, tall places), clear waypoints
                        currentWaypoints = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            if currentWaypoints and currentWaypointIndex <= #currentWaypoints then
                local targetWp = currentWaypoints[currentWaypointIndex].Position
                humanoid:MoveTo(targetWp)
                
                if (root.Position - Vector3.new(targetWp.X, root.Position.Y, targetWp.Z)).Magnitude < 3.5 then
                    currentWaypointIndex = currentWaypointIndex + 1
                end
            else
                -- Freeze if target is unreachable (behind door/tall place), but maintain run tool
                humanoid:MoveTo(root.Position)
            end
        end

        if distToTarget <= KILL_DISTANCE and (os.clock() - chaseStartTime) >= MIN_CHASE_DURATION then
            transitionToKill(targetHum)
        end

    elseif currentState == "KILL" then
        if currentTarget then
            local targetRoot = currentTarget:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTarget:FindFirstChild("Torso")
            if targetRoot then humanoid:MoveTo(targetRoot.Position) end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- Fly Script + Vehicle Fly + Noclip + GUI (executor version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- ============ STATE ============
local flying = false
local speed = 60
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro, flyConnection

local noclipEnabled = false
local noclipConnection

local vehicleFlyEnabled = false
local vehicleFlyActive = false
local vehicleBodyVelocity, vehicleBodyGyro
local vehicleRoot
local vehicleRenderConnection
local vehicleMonitorConnection
local savedCameraSubject
local savedCameraType

local ui = {}
local connections = {}

-- ============ FORWARD DECLARATIONS ============
local updateFlyButton
local updateNoclipButton
local updateVehicleFlyButton

local function track(conn)
    connections[#connections + 1] = conn
    return conn
end
local function disconnectAll()
    for _, c in ipairs(connections) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    connections = {}
end

-- ============ ANTI-RAGDOLL ============
local RAGDOLL_STATES = {
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll,
    Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics,
}
local function disableRagdollStates(h)
    for _, s in ipairs(RAGDOLL_STATES) do
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(s, false) end)
    end
end
local function restoreRagdollStates(h)
    for _, s in ipairs(RAGDOLL_STATES) do
        pcall(function() h:SetStateEnabled(s, true) end)
    end
end

-- ============ CHARACTER FLY ============
local function startFly()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or flying then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not humanoid then return end
    if humanoid.Sit then return end

    flying = true
    disableRagdollStates(humanoid)
    humanoid.PlatformStand = true

    bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    bodyVelocity.Parent = hrp

    bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyGyro.P = 10000
    bodyGyro.D = 500
    bodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
    bodyGyro.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not bodyVelocity or not bodyGyro then return end
        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local camCF = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and (dir.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
    end)
end

local function stopFly()
    flying = false
    if flyConnection then flyConnection:Disconnect() flyConnection = nil end
    if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

    local char = player.Character
    if char then
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
            humanoid.Sit = false
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
            pcall(function() humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
            task.delay(0.25, function()
                if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                    restoreRagdollStates(humanoid)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end

-- ============ NOCLIP ============
local function startNoclip()
    if noclipEnabled then return end
    noclipEnabled = true
    noclipConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        local char = player.Character
        if not char then return end
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                part.CanCollide = false
            end
        end
    end)
end
local function stopNoclip()
    noclipEnabled = false
    if noclipConnection then noclipConnection:Disconnect() noclipConnection = nil end
end

-- ============ VEHICLE FLY ============
local function getSeatAndRoot()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil, nil end
    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or not humanoid.Sit then return nil, nil end
    local seat = humanoid.SeatPart
    if not seat then return nil, nil end
    local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local root = (model and model.PrimaryPart) or seat
    return seat, root
end

local function startVehicleFly()
    if vehicleFlyActive then return end
    local seat, root = getSeatAndRoot()
    if not seat or not root then return end
    vehicleRoot = root
    vehicleFlyActive = true

    if flying then stopFly() end

    vehicleBodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    vehicleBodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    vehicleBodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    vehicleBodyVelocity.Parent = vehicleRoot

    vehicleBodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    vehicleBodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    vehicleBodyGyro.P = 10000
    vehicleBodyGyro.D = 500
    vehicleBodyGyro.CFrame = vehicleRoot.CFrame
    vehicleBodyGyro.Parent = vehicleRoot

    -- ----- SIMPLE CAMERA FIX -----
    -- Just retarget the camera to the vehicle chassis. The default camera
    -- script handles smoothing itself; no Scriptable mode, no fighting.
    savedCameraSubject = camera.CameraSubject
    savedCameraType = camera.CameraType
    camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    camera.CameraSubject = vehicleRoot

    local yaw = 0
    local lastUpdate = 0

    vehicleRenderConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not vehicleFlyActive or not vehicleRoot or not vehicleRoot.Parent then return end

        -- Re-assert camera subject in case the engine resets it while seated
        if camera.CameraSubject ~= vehicleRoot then
            camera.CameraSubject = vehicleRoot
        end

        -- Yaw from camera so movement is camera-relative
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)

        local dir = Vector3.zero
        local camCF = camera.CFrame
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then dir += camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then dir -= camCF.LookVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then dir -= camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then dir += camCF.RightVector end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then dir += Vector3.yAxis end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then dir -= Vector3.yAxis end

        vehicleBodyVelocity.Velocity = dir.Magnitude > 0 and (dir.Unit * speed) or Vector3.zero
        -- Flat yaw-only orientation so the vehicle doesn't tumble
        vehicleBodyGyro.CFrame = CFrame.new(vehicleRoot.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
    end)
end

local function stopVehicleFly()
    if not vehicleFlyActive then
        -- Still restore camera in case something got left over
        if savedCameraSubject then
            camera.CameraSubject = savedCameraSubject
            savedCameraSubject = nil
        end
        return
    end
    vehicleFlyActive = false

    if vehicleRenderConnection then vehicleRenderConnection:Disconnect() vehicleRenderConnection = nil end
    if vehicleBodyVelocity then vehicleBodyVelocity:Destroy() vehicleBodyVelocity = nil end
    if vehicleBodyGyro then vehicleBodyGyro:Destroy() vehicleBodyGyro = nil end
    vehicleRoot = nil

    -- Restore camera
    local char = player.Character
    local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    camera.CameraType = savedCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
    camera.CameraSubject = humanoid or savedCameraSubject
    savedCameraSubject = nil
    savedCameraType = nil
end

local function refreshVehicleMonitor()
    if vehicleMonitorConnection then
        vehicleMonitorConnection:Disconnect()
        vehicleMonitorConnection = nil
    end
    if not vehicleFlyEnabled then
        if vehicleFlyActive then stopVehicleFly() end
        return
    end
    vehicleMonitorConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local _, root = getSeatAndRoot()
        if root then
            if not vehicleFlyActive then startVehicleFly() end
        else
            if vehicleFlyActive then stopVehicleFly() end
        end
    end)
end

local function toggleVehicleFly()
    vehicleFlyEnabled = not vehicleFlyEnabled
    refreshVehicleMonitor()
    if updateVehicleFlyButton then updateVehicleFlyButton() end
end

-- ============ UI HELPERS (assign to forward-declared locals) ============
updateFlyButton = function()
    if not ui.flyBtn then return end
    if flying then
        ui.flyBtn.Text = "Fly: ON  [E]"
        ui.flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 80)
    else
        ui.flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF  [E]"
        ui.flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80)
    end
end

updateNoclipButton = function()
    if not ui.noclipBtn then return end
    if noclipEnabled then
        ui.noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: ON"
        ui.noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 80)
    else
        ui.noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: OFF"
        ui.noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80)
    end
end

updateVehicleFlyButton = function()
    if not ui.vehicleBtn then return end
    if vehicleFlyEnabled then
        ui.vehicleBtn.Text = "Vehicle Fly: ON  [V]"
        ui.vehicleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 80)
    else
        ui.vehicleBtn.Text = "Vehicle Fly: OFF  [V]"
        ui.vehicleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80)
    end
end

local function toggleFly()
    if flying then stopFly() else startFly() end
    updateFlyButton()
end
local function toggleNoclip()
    if noclipEnabled then stopNoclip() else startNoclip() end
    updateNoclipButton()
end

-- ============ DRAGGABLE ============
local function makeDraggable(frame, dragBar)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos
    track(dragBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            track(input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end))
        end
    end))
    track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end))
end

    -- speed

        if filtered ~= speedBox.Text then speedBox.Text = filtered end
    end))

        local n = tonumber(speedBox.Text) or 60
        n = math.clamp(math.floor(n), 1, 1000)
        speed = n
        speedBox.Text = tostring(n)
    end))

    track(flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly))
    track(noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleNoclip))
    track(vehicleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleVehicleFly))

    -- hover
    track(flyBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if not flying then flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(85, 85, 95) end

        closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
    end))
    track(closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80)
    end))

    makeDraggable(frame, titleBar)

    -- close everything
    track(closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        stopFly()
        stopNoclip()
        vehicleFlyEnabled = false
        stopVehicleFly()
        if vehicleMonitorConnection then
            vehicleMonitorConnection:Disconnect()
            vehicleMonitorConnection = nil
        end
        disconnectAll()
        if ui.gui then ui.gui:Destroy() end
        ui = {}
    end))
end

                    Part.Velocity = Network.Velocity
                end

        end)
    end

    EnablePartControl()
end

-- Force part for AlignPosition / Torque
local function ForcePart(v)
    if v:IsA("Part") and not v.Anchored and not v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and not v.Parent:FindFirstChild("Head") and v.Name ~= "Handle" then
        for _, x in next, v:GetChildren() do
            if x:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") or x:IsA("BodyForce") or x:IsA("BodyGyro") or x:IsA("BodyPosition") or x:IsA("BodyThrust") or x:IsA("BodyVelocity") or x:IsA("RocketPropulsion") then
                x:Destroy()

-- Tornado / Ring Logic
local radius = 50
local height = 100
local rotationSpeed = 0.5
local attractionStrength = 1000
local ringPartsEnabled = false
local parts = {}

local function RetainPart(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part.Anchored and part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
        if part:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) then return false end
        part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0,0,0,0,0)
        part.CanCollide = false
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function addPart(part)
    if RetainPart(part) and not table.find(parts,part) then
        table.insert(parts,part)
    end
end
local function removePart(part)
    local idx = table.find(parts,part)
    if idx then table.remove(parts,idx) end
end

    if not ringPartsEnabled then return end

        local center = humanoidRootPart.Position
        for _, part in pairs(parts) do
            if part.Parent and not part.Anchored then
                local pos = part.Position
                local dist = (Vector3.new(pos.X, center.Y, pos.Z) - center).Magnitude
                local angle = math.atan2(pos.Z - center.Z, pos.X - center.X)
                local newAngle = angle + math.rad(rotationSpeed)
                local targetPos = Vector3.new(
                    center.X + math.cos(newAngle) * math.min(radius, dist),
                    center.Y + (height * math.abs(math.sin((pos.Y - center.Y)/height))),
                    center.Z + math.sin(newAngle) * math.min(radius, dist)
                )
                local dir = (targetPos - part.Position).Unit
                part.Velocity = dir * attractionStrength
            end
        end
    end
end)
