--[[
    Universal FE Menu for Delta Executor
    Включает: Полёт, Ноуклип, Клонирование, Рост
]]

-- Настройки
local maxClones = 5 -- Максимум клонов
local maxScale = 5 -- Максимальный рост
local minScale = 0.5 -- Минимальный рост
local stepSize = 0.5 -- Шаг роста

-- Основные переменные
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Состояния
local flyEnabled = false
local noclipEnabled = false
local flySpeed = 50
local currentScale = 1
local clones = {}

-- Создаём GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "UniversalMenu"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Главная кнопка меню
local menuButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
menuButton.Name = "MenuButton"
menuButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
menuButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
menuButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
menuButton.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
menuButton.Text = "⚙️"
menuButton.TextSize = 30
menuButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
menuButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
menuButton.Parent = screenGui

-- Главная панель меню
local mainPanel = Instance.new("Frame")
mainPanel.Name = "MainPanel"
mainPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 500)
mainPanel.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -175, 0.5, -250)
mainPanel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
mainPanel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
mainPanel.Visible = false
mainPanel.Parent = screenGui

-- Заголовок
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "TitleLabel"
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
titleLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
titleLabel.Text = "Universal FE Menu"
titleLabel.TextSize = 20
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
titleLabel.Parent = mainPanel

-- Кнопка закрытия
local closeButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeButton.Name = "CloseButton"
closeButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
closeButton.Position = UDim2.new(1, -45, 0, 0)
closeButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
closeButton.Text = "X"
closeButton.TextSize = 20
closeButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeButton.Parent = mainPanel

-- Функция создания кнопки-переключателя
local function createToggle(parent, name, yPos, callback)
    local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggleButton.Name = name .. "Toggle"
    toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
    toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, yPos)
    toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    toggleButton.Text = name .. ": Выкл"
    toggleButton.TextSize = 16
    toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    toggleButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    toggleButton.Parent = parent
    
    local enabled = false
    toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        enabled = not enabled
        toggleButton.Text = name .. ": " .. (enabled and "Вкл" or "Выкл")
        toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = enabled and Color3.new(0, 0.5, 0) or Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
        callback(enabled)
    end)
    
    return toggleButton
end

-- Функция создания кнопки действия
local function createActionButton(parent, name, yPos, callback)
    local actionButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    actionButton.Name = name .. "Button"
    actionButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
    actionButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, yPos)
    actionButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    actionButton.Text = name
    actionButton.TextSize = 16
    actionButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    actionButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    actionButton.Parent = parent
    
    actionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return actionButton
end

-- Функция создания ползунка
local function createSlider(parent, name, yPos, min, max, defaultValue, callback)
    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Name = name .. "Label"
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 30)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, yPos)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Text = name
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    label.Parent = parent
    
    local sliderButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    sliderButton.Name = name .. "Slider"
    sliderButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 30)
    sliderButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, yPos)
    sliderButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)
    sliderButton.Text = tostring(defaultValue)
    sliderButton.TextSize = 14
    sliderButton.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    sliderButton.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sliderButton.Parent = parent
    
    local value = defaultValue
    sliderButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        value = value + (max - min) / 10
        if value > max then value = min end
        sliderButton.Text = string.format("%.1f", value)
        callback(value)
    end)
    
    sliderButton.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
        value = value - (max - min) / 10
        if value < min then value = max end
        sliderButton.Text = string.format("%.1f", value)
        callback(value)
    end)
    
    return sliderButton
end

-- ФУНКЦИИ МЕНЮ

-- Функция полёта
local function toggleFly(enabled)
    flyEnabled = enabled
    if flyEnabled then
        -- Включаем полёт
        local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVelocity.Name = "FlyVelocity"
        bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 1e6
        bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart
        
        local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bodyGyro.Name = "FlyGyro"
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1) * 1e6
        bodyGyro.DFrame = CFrame.new()
        bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart
        
        -- Управление полётом
        local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
        
        game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if flyEnabled and rootPart then
                local moveDirection = Vector3.new()
                
                -- Управление на ПК
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection - (rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection - (rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * flySpeed)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                end
                if userInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                    moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                end
                
                -- Управление на мобильных
                local touch = userInputService:GetTouches()
                for _, touchInput in ipairs(touch) do
                    local position = touchInput.Position
                    local screenSize = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
                    
                    if position.X > screenSize.X / 2 then
                        -- Правая половина - вверх/вниз
                        if position.Y < screenSize.Y / 2 then
                            moveDirection = moveDirection + Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                        else
                            moveDirection = moveDirection - Vector3.new(0, flySpeed, 0)
                        end
                    else
                        -- Левая половина - движение
                        local centerX = screenSize.X / 4
                        local centerY = screenSize.Y / 2
                        local deltaX = position.X - centerX
                        local deltaY = position.Y - centerY
                        
                        moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.RightVector * (deltaX / 100) * flySpeed)
                        moveDirection = moveDirection + (rootPart.CFrame.LookVector * (deltaY / 100) * flySpeed)
                    end
                end
                
                bodyVelocity.Velocity = moveDirection
            end
        end)
    else
        -- Выключаем полёт
        local bodyVelocity = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
        local bodyGyro = rootPart:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
        if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
        if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
    end
end

-- Функция ноуклипа
local function toggleNoclip(enabled)
    noclipEnabled = enabled
    game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function()
        if noclipEnabled and character then
            for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

-- Функция клонирования
local function cloneCharacter()
    if #clones >= maxClones then
        game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
            Title = "Клонирование",
            Text = "Достигнут лимит клонов (" .. maxClones .. ")!",
            Duration = 2
        })
        return
    end
    
    local clone = character:Clone()
    clone.Name = "Clone_" .. #clones + 1
    clone.Parent = workspace
    
    -- Позиционируем клон рядом
    local cloneRoot = clone:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    cloneRoot.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(5, 0, 0)
    
    -- Убираем контроллер
    local cloneHumanoid = clone:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    cloneHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
    
    -- Добавляем в список
    table.insert(clones, clone)
    
    -- Анимация появления
    local effect = Instance.new("Part")
    effect.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
    effect.Transparency = 0.5
    effect.CanCollide = false
    effect.Anchored = true
    effect.CFrame = cloneRoot.CFrame
    effect.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    effect.Color = Color3.new(0, 1, 1)
    effect.Parent = workspace
    
    task.delay(1, function()
        effect:Destroy()
    end)
    
    game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Клонирование",
        Text = "Клон создан! (" .. #clones .. "/" .. maxClones .. ")",
        Duration = 2
    })
end

-- Функция удаления клонов
local function deleteClones()
    for _, clone in ipairs(clones) do
        if clone then
            clone:Destroy()
        end
    end
    clones = {}
    
    game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Клонирование",
        Text = "Все клоны удалены!",
        Duration = 2
    })
end

-- Функция изменения роста
local function setScale(scale)
    scale = math.clamp(scale, minScale, maxScale)
    currentScale = scale
    
    if humanoid then
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local originalSize = part:GetAttribute("OriginalSize")
                if not originalSize then
                    part:SetAttribute("OriginalSize", part.Size)
                    originalSize = part.Size
                end
                part.Size = originalSize * scale
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Создаём элементы меню
createToggle(mainPanel, "Полёт", 60, toggleFly)
createToggle(mainPanel, "Ноуклип", 110, toggleNoclip)
createActionButton(mainPanel, "Клонировать себя", 160, cloneCharacter)
createActionButton(mainPanel, "Удалить клонов", 210, deleteClones)
createSlider(mainPanel, "Скорость полёта", 260, 10, 200, flySpeed, function(value)
    flySpeed = value
end)
createSlider(mainPanel, "Рост", 310, minScale, maxScale, currentScale, setScale)
createActionButton(mainPanel, "Сбросить рост", 360, function()
    setScale(1)
end)

-- Обработчики кнопок
menuButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    mainPanel.Visible = not mainPanel.Visible
end)

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    mainPanel.Visible = false
end)

-- Отслеживаем смену персонажа
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    character = newChar
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    
    -- Применяем текущий рост
    task.wait(0.1)
    setScale(currentScale)
end)

-- Уведомление о загрузке
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "Universal FE Menu",
    Text = "Нажми ⚙️ для открытия меню!",
    Duration = 3
})

local function num(v)
	if v ~= v then return "(0/0)" end
	if v == math.huge then return "math.huge" end
	if v == -math.huge then return "-math.huge" end
	return ("%.17g"):format(v)
end

local function emitVal(v)
	local t = typeof(v)
	if t == "number" then return num(v) end
	if t == "boolean" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "string" then return ("%q"):format(v) end
	if t == "EnumItem" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "BrickColor" then return ('BrickColor.new("%s")'):format(v.Name) end
	if t == "Vector3" then return ("Vector3.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y), num(v.Z)) end
	if t == "Vector2" then return ("Vector2.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X), num(v.Y)) end
	if t == "Color3" then return ("Color3.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.R), num(v.G), num(v.B)) end
	if t == "UDim2" then return ("UDim2.new(%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.X.Scale), num(v.X.Offset), num(v.Y.Scale), num(v.Y.Offset)) end
	if t == "UDim" then return ("UDim.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Scale), num(v.Offset)) end
	if t == "CFrame" then
		local x,y,z,r00,r01,r02,r10,r11,r12,r20,r21,r22 = v:GetComponents()
		return ("CFrame.new(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(x),num(y),num(z),num(r00),num(r01),num(r02),num(r10),num(r11),num(r12),num(r20),num(r21),num(r22))
	end
	if t == "NumberRange" then return ("NumberRange.new(%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Min), num(v.Max)) end
	if t == "NumberSequence" then
		local p = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(v.Keypoints) do p[#p+1] = ("NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(k.Time), num(k.Value), num(k.Envelope)) end
		return "NumberSequence.new({" .. table.concat(p, ",") .. "})"
	end
	if t == "ColorSequence" then
		local p = {}
		for _, k in ipairs(v.Keypoints) do p[#p+1] = ("ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(%s,Color3.new(%s,%s,%s))"):format(num(k.Time), num(k.Value.R), num(k.Value.G), num(k.Value.B)) end
		return "ColorSequence.new({" .. table.concat(p, ",") .. "})"
	end
	if t == "PhysicalProperties" then return ("PhysicalProperties.new(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Density), num(v.Friction), num(v.Elasticity), num(v.FrictionWeight), num(v.ElasticityWeight)) end
	if t == "Rect" then return ("Rect.new(%s,%s,%s,%s)"):format(num(v.Min.X), num(v.Min.Y), num(v.Max.X), num(v.Max.Y)) end
	if t == "Font" then return ('Font.new(%q,%s,%s)'):format(v.Family, tostring(v.Weight), tostring(v.Style)) end
	return nil
end

local function isValidMeshId(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" then return false end
	local t = id:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if t == "" or t == "0" or t == "rbxassetid://0" or t == "rbxassetid://" or t == "rbxasset://" then return false end
	local l = t:lower()
	if l == "none" or l == "null" or l:find("meshpartfallback") then return false end
	return true
end

local function readMeshId(o)
	local ok, v = pcall(function() return o.MeshId end)
	if ok and isValidMeshId(v) then return v end
	local ok2, c = pcall(function() return o.MeshContent end)
	if ok2 and c then
		local ok3, uri = pcall(function() return c.Uri end)
		if ok3 and isValidMeshId(uri) then return uri end
		local s = tostring(c)
		if (s:match("^rbxasset") or s:match("^http")) and isValidMeshId(s) then return s end
	end
	return nil
end

local function propListFor(c)
	local l, seen = {}, {}
	local function add(k) if not seen[k] then seen[k] = true; l[#l+1] = k end end
	if PART_LIKE[c] or c == "Part" then for _, k in ipairs(prup) do add(k) end end
	if x_prup[c] then for _, k in ipairs(x_prup[c]) do add(k) end end
	for k in pairs(ref_prup) do add(k) end
	return l
end

local function captureActiveAnimations(root)
	local active = {}
	local hum = root:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or root:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
	if hum then
		local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
		if animator then
			local ok, tracks = pcall(function() return animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() end)
			if ok and tracks and #tracks > 0 then
				for _, trk in ipairs(tracks) do
					if trk.IsPlaying and trk.Animation then
						table.insert(active, {
							id = trk.Animation.AnimationId,
							name = trk.Animation.Name,
							speed = trk.Speed,
							weight = trk.WeightCurrent,
							timePos = trk.TimePosition,
							looped = trk.Looped,
							priority = trk.Priority.Name
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #active == 0 then
		for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("Animation") and (d.Name:lower():find("idle") or (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name:lower():find("idle"))) then
				table.insert(active, {
					id = d.AnimationId,
					name = d.Name,
					speed = 1,
					weight = 1,
					timePos = 0,
					looped = true,
					priority = "Idle"
				})
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return active
end

local function serializeSelection(sel)
	local set, roots = {}, {}
	for _, o in ipairs(sel) do set[o] = true end
	for _, o in ipairs(sel) do
		local p, isRoot = o.Parent, true
		while p do if set[p] then isRoot = false; break end; p = p.Parent end
		if isRoot then roots[#roots+1] = o end
	end
	if #roots == 0 then return nil end
	local root, records, index = roots[1], {}, {}

	local activeAnims = captureActiveAnimations(root)

	local function walk(o, pIdx)
		local c = CLASS_CONV[o.ClassName] or o.ClassName
		if SKIP_CLASSES[c] then return end

		local isScript = (c == "Script" or c == "LocalScript" or c == "ModuleScript")
		local isMP = (c == "MeshPart") or (pcall(function() return o:IsA("MeshPart") end) and o:IsA("MeshPart"))
		local mId = nil
		if isMP then
			c = "MeshPart"
			mId = readMeshId(o)
		end

		local rec = {c = c, n = o.Name, p = pIdx, props = {}, refs = {}}
		records[#records+1] = rec
		local myIdx = #records
		index[o] = myIdx

		if isMP and mId then rec.mesh = mId end

		for _, k in ipairs(propListFor(c)) do
			local ok, v = pcall(function() return o[k] end)
			if ok and v ~= nil then
				if typeof(v) == "Instance" then
					if ref_prup[k] then rec.refs[k] = v end
				else
					local ev = emitVal(v)
					if ev then rec.props[k] = ev end
				end
			end
		end

		if isScript then
			local okS, src = pcall(function() return o.Source end)
			if okS and src then rec.props["Source"] = ("%q"):format(src) end
		end

		local okA, attrs = pcall(function() return o:GetAttributes() end)
		if okA and type(attrs) == "table" then
			for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
				local ev = emitVal(v)
				if ev then rec.attrs = rec.attrs or {}; rec.attrs[k] = ev end
			end
		end

		if c == "Animation" and o.AnimationId and o.AnimationId ~= "" then
			pcall(function()
				local kfs = KeyframeSequenceProvider:GetKeyframeSequenceAsync(o.AnimationId)
				if kfs and kfs:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
					walk(kfs, myIdx)
				end
			end)
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do walk(child, myIdx) end
	end

	walk(root, 0)

	for o, i in pairs(index) do
		for k, target in pairs(records[i].refs) do records[i].refs[k] = index[target] end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(records) do
		for k in pairs(r.refs) do if type(r.refs[k]) ~= "number" then r.refs[k] = nil end end
		if next(r.refs) == nil then r.refs = nil end
		if next(r.props) == nil then r.props = nil end
	end
	return records, root.Name, #records, activeAnims
end

local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

local function setProp(o, k, v)
	o[k] = v
end

local function setRef(o, k, target)
	o[k] = target
end

local mCache = {}
local function create(r)
	if r.c == "MeshPart" then
		if r.mesh then
			local t = mCache[r.mesh]
			if t == nil then
				local ok, res = pcall(function()
					return AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(r.mesh), {
						CollisionFidelity = (r.props and r.props.CollisionFidelity) or Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box
					})
				end)
				t = (ok and res) or false
				mCache[r.mesh] = t
			end
			if t then return t:Clone() end
		end
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		if r.mesh then
			local sm = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
			sm.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
			sm.MeshId = r.mesh
			if r.props and r.props.TextureID then sm.TextureId = r.props.TextureID end
			sm.Parent = part
		end
		return part
	end
	return Instance.new(r.c)
end

for i = 1, total do

for i = 1, total do

local function getBaseCF()
	local pl = Players.LocalPlayer or Players:FindFirstChildOfClass("Player")
	local c = pl and (pl.Character or pl.CharacterAdded:Wait())
	local hrp = c and c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
	if hrp then return hrp.CFrame end
	local sp = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpawnLocation", true)
	return sp and (sp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 4, 0)) or CFrame.new(0, 6, 0)
end

							track.Looped = (animData.looped ~= nil) and animData.looped or true
							track:Play(0.1, animData.weight or 1, animData.speed or 1)
							if animData.timePos and animData.timePos > 0 then
								track.TimePosition = animData.timePos
							end
						end)
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end
end
]===]

local function generateCode(name, records, anchorMode, playAnims, activeAnims)
	local animLines = {}
	for _, a in ipairs(activeAnims) do
		animLines[#animLines + 1] = ('\t{ id = %q, name = %q, speed = %s, weight = %s, timePos = %s, looped = %s, priority = %q },'):format(
			a.id, a.name, num(a.speed), num(a.weight), num(a.timePos), tostring(a.looped), a.priority
		)
	end

	local lines = {
		"local CONFIG = {",
		('\tNAME            = %q,'):format(name),
		"\tOFFSET          = CFrame.new(0, 0, -6),",
		('\tANCHOR_MODE     = %q,'):format(anchorMode),
		('\tPLAY_ANIMATIONS = %s,'):format(tostring(playAnims)),
		"\tREPLACE         = true,",
		"}",
		"",
		"local ACTIVE_ANIMS = {",
		table.concat(animLines, "\n"),
		"}",
		"",
		"local DATA = {"
	}

	for _, r in ipairs(records) do
		local p = {('c=%q'):format(r.c), ('n=%q'):format(r.n), ('p=%d'):format(r.p)}
		if r.mesh then p[#p+1] = ('mesh=%q'):format(r.mesh) end
		if r.props then
			local pl = {}
			for k, v in pairs(r.props) do pl[#pl+1] = ("%s=%s"):format(k, v) end
			table.sort(pl)
			p[#p+1] = "props={" .. table.concat(pl, ",") .. "}"
		end
		if r.refs then
			local rl = {}
			for k, idx in pairs(r.refs) do rl[#rl+1] = ("%s=%d"):format(k, idx) end
			table.sort(rl)
			p[#p+1] = "refs={" .. table.concat(rl, ",") .. "}"
		end
		if r.attrs then
			local al = {}
			for k, v in pairs(r.attrs) do al[#al+1] = ("[%q]=%s"):format(k, v) end
			table.sort(al)
			p[#p+1] = "attrs={" .. table.concat(al, ",") .. "}"
		end
		lines[#lines+1] = "\t{ " .. table.concat(p, ", ") .. " },"
	end
	lines[#lines+1] = "}\n"
	return table.concat(lines, "\n") .. RUNTIME
end

local function Create(instance, parent, props)
  local new = Instance.new(instance)
  if props then
    for prop, value in pairs(props) do
      new[prop] = value
    end
  end
  new.Parent = parent
  return new
end

local function SetProps(instance, props)
  if instance and props then
    for prop, value in pairs(props) do
      instance[prop] = value
    end
  end
  return instance
end

local function Corner(parent, props)
  local new = Create("UICorner", parent)
  new.CornerRadius = Configs_HUB.Corner_Radius
  if props then SetProps(new, props) end
  return new
end

local function Stroke(parent, props)
  local new = Create("UIStroke", parent)
  new.Color = Configs_HUB.Cor_Stroke
  new.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  new.Thickness = 2
  
  local gradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  gradient.Color = ColorSequence.new{
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 20)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))
  }
  gradient.Rotation = 0
  gradient.Parent = new
  
  coroutine.wrap(function()
    while new.Parent do
      gradient.Rotation = (gradient.Rotation + 2) % 360
      RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
    end
  end)()
  
  if props then SetProps(new, props) end
  return new
end

local function CreateTween(instance, prop, value, time, tweenWait)
  local tween = TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {[prop] = value})
  tween:Play()
  if tweenWait then tween.Completed:Wait() end
end

local function MakeDraggable(gui)
  local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
  gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragging = true
      dragStart = input.Position
      startPos = gui.Position

      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
      end)
    end
  end)

  gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)

  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
      local delta = input.Position - dragStart
      gui.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
  end)
end

local function GetPlayerByString(str)
    if not str or str == "" then return nil end
    str = str:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower()
    
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local name = plr.Name:lower()
        local displayName = plr.DisplayName:lower()
        if string.find(name, str, 1, true) or string.find(displayName, str, 1, true) then
            return plr
        end
    end
    return nil
end

        freezeConnection:Disconnect()
        freezeConnection = nil
    end
    FreezeButton.Visible = true
    UnfreezeButton.Visible = false
    SendNotification("تم إلغاء التجميد بنجاح ✅")
end

BindClick(FreezeButton, function()

    isFrozen = true
    FreezeButton.Visible = false
    UnfreezeButton.Visible = true
    SendNotification("تم تجميد اللاعب بنجاح 🧊")

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local hrp = char.HumanoidRootPart
        local frozenCFrame = hrp.CFrame

        freezeConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not isFrozen then return end
            local currentTargetChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            if currentTargetChar and currentTargetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local currentHrp = currentTargetChar.HumanoidRootPart
                currentHrp.CFrame = frozenCFrame
                pcall(function()
                    currentHrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    currentHrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Freecam Script for Roblox (Persistent Executor Version)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Variables to keep track of current character state
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)

local freecamEnabled = false
local speed = 240 -- Camera movement speed
local sensitivity = 0.6 -- Mouse sensitivity

-- Store original settings
local originalWalkSpeed = humanoid and humanoid.WalkSpeed or 16
local originalJumpPower = humanoid and humanoid.JumpPower or 50

-- Camera rotation variables
local rotationX = 0
local rotationY = 0

-- Movement keys
local keys = {
    W = false,
    A = false,
    S = false,
    D = false,
    Q = false, -- Down
    E = false, -- Up
    LeftShift = false -- Speed boost
}

-- Function to safely reset camera
local function resetCameraToDefault()
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    
    local currentHumanoid = character or (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
    if currentHumanoid then
        Camera.CameraSubject = currentHumanoid
    end
    
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
    
    if character and character.Parent then
        local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = false end
        if currentHumanoidObj then
            currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = originalWalkSpeed or 16
            currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = originalJumpPower or 50
        end
    end
    
    for key, _ in pairs(keys) do
        keys[key] = false
    end
    
    freecamEnabled = false
end

-- Function to enable freecam
local function enableFreecam()
    if not character or not character.Parent then return end
    
    freecamEnabled = true
    Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
    UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    
    local x, y, z = Camera.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    rotationX = x
    rotationY = y
    
    local currentRoot = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local currentHumanoidObj = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if currentRoot then currentRoot.Anchored = true end
    if currentHumanoidObj then
        currentHumanoidObj.WalkSpeed = 0
        currentHumanoidObj.JumpPower = 0
    end
end

-- Track key presses
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.T then
        if freecamEnabled then
            resetCameraToDefault()
        else
            enableFreecam()
        end
    end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.R and input:IsModifierKeyDown(Enum.ModifierKey.Ctrl) then
        resetCameraToDefault()
        print("Emergency camera reset activated!")
    end
    
    if freecamEnabled and keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = true
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if keys[input.KeyCode.Name] ~= nil then
        keys[input.KeyCode.Name] = false
    end
end)

-- Mouse movement for camera rotation
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        local delta = input.Delta
        rotationY = rotationY - delta.X * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = rotationX - delta.Y * sensitivity * 0.01
        rotationX = math.clamp(rotationX, -math.pi/2 + 0.01, math.pi/2 - 0.01)
    end
end)

-- Update camera position
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    if not freecamEnabled then return end
    
    if UserInputService.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter then
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = false
    end
    
    local movementSpeed = speed
    if keys.LeftShift then
        movementSpeed = speed * 2
    end
    
    local cameraRotation = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(rotationX, rotationY, 0)
    local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    
    if keys.W then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, -1)).Position end
    if keys.S then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, 1)).Position end
    if keys.A then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(-1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.D then moveVector = moveVector + (cameraRotation * CFrame.new(1, 0, 0)).Position end
    if keys.E then moveVector = moveVector + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    if keys.Q then moveVector = moveVector - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
    
    if moveVector.Magnitude > 0 then
        moveVector = moveVector.Unit
    end
    
    local newPosition = Camera.CFrame.Position + moveVector * movementSpeed * deltaTime
    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(newPosition) * cameraRotation
end)

-- CRITICAL FIX: Automatically update variables when you respawn, without breaking the script loops
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
    freecamEnabled = false
    character = newCharacter
    humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
    rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
    
    if humanoid then
        originalWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
        originalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
    end
end)

local function PDDUG_fake_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local frame = script.Parent
	local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	
	local dragging = false
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		if not dragging then return end
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	userInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
	
end
